checks: Status requires matching current/approved evidence; repair and failed refresh clear approval; accessible badge refresh recovers
Loading immediately removes a verified badge; focus/Realtime bursts coalesce to one read plus one follow-up; pending/failed/revoked statuses warn with one Settings channel
Sidebar placement, four steps, shared validation, explicit-only OCR, trimmed review, Previous, edited/cleared-field protection and birthday Cancel/confirm/clear/focus
Recoverable quota/key failures expose explicit retry only; typing/Previous do not retry and manual details survive

Failed/invalid and same-file replacements preserve the draft; accepted replacement resets details; quota permits manual submission; lost RPC response reconciles the same ID; confirmed success survives failed status refresh
Synchronous double click produces one attempt; a missing reconciliation row retries the same ID and identical immutable photo
A transaction committing after a not-found read is retried with the identical payload/ID; confirmed success refreshes status without remounting the route
Failed or mismatched owned-row reads keep the snapshot locked without writes or false success; resolving an older version preserves and identifies the newer current submission
Confirmed success uses fresh staff decisions without forcing pending; later status refreshes preserve success and never republish or refresh the route
Definitive validation/access rejections show safe feedback and retain the editable draft; a deliberate correction gets a new identity only after that resolved rejection
Actual REST deadline ends a held publication spinner as unknown; a later committed row resolves through an explicit owned-ID read without another publication
A same-ID retry rejects different saved image bytes without overwriting or publishing them; restoring identical bytes resolves the original snapshot
OCR cancel/review navigation invalidates late replies; logout clears the draft and returning creates a fresh draft
Camera starts only on click, denial allows upload, ignored permission can be cancelled, late permission tracks are stopped
Canvas-backed live video capture creates the same uploaded front-photo draft and closes its stream
Real decoder accepts exact 5,242,880-byte evidence; empty and one-byte-over candidates preserve the accepted photo
Real browser WebP conversion creates a separate capped JPEG; encoding failure stops after three attempts
Three failed derivative encodes make no upload/provider request, preserve corrections and original evidence, and permit complete manual publication
Malformed, empty and partial OCR replies preserve manual edits, reject over-limit/invalid suggestions and allow complete publication without automatic retries
Actual OCR transport timeout ends loading; a late response cannot change manual publication or start another read
Normal Profile validates locally, preserves edits after a rejected save, writes only personal fields and retains its ordinary birthday calendar
Retained avatar upload failure permits same-file retry; success updates only avatar_url and decodes the public profile image
Actual household hook supports failed add with preserved dialog, explicit retry, edit and remove without writing ID approval
Both web verification entry points use Valid ID while Edit in Profile stays on Profile; older portal destinations/copy and legacy request attachments remain intact
Actual service evidence reader decodes front-only and historical two-sided private previews without changing stored evidence
Complete and incomplete Profile component fixtures hand old fragments off once, normal navigation stays on Profile, and later hash changes hand off without a cycle
Type changes cancel stale OCR without clearing corrections; cancelled/stale uploads cannot replace the photo or restore an old account draft
360/768/1440px and dark/200% layout, actual retained Profile/avatar/household controls, one-way old-fragment handoff and one Settings channel
Birthday focus stays trapped; backdrop/Cancel/Escape preserve the form; leap-year changes clamp the day; an open wheel is protected from late OCR
Actual browser wheel with fixed Manila clocks at 00:01 and 08:01 caps dates at the earlier local/UTC day and passes shared review validation
Existing admin and resident promoted during a draft retain the same upload, required-name validation, optional OCR, correction, publication, lost-response recovery and pending staff review
A deleted admin profile remains unable to submit an ID
No unexpected runtime/console errors or warnings; synthetic failure responses are identified separately
Every network destination is checked; browser requests stay on the fixture app/backend with no direct provider or Google call
